description: Connects a laboratory test to the cell type that is its analyte, as represented by the LOINC Component axis. Examples include cell-count analytes such as erythrocytes and cell morphology findings such as neutrophil toxic granulation.

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.description: Data sources contributing this relationship; contains LOINC.

source_contributions.scope: Laboratory codes (CLASSTYPE = 1) with ACTIVE, TRIAL, or DISCOURAGED status; DEPRECATED codes are excluded. Targets are CellType entities represented in SPOKE.
source_contributions.description: Describes the cell type being measured or characterized, rather than the specimen in which a measurement is taken. Includes curated relationships for erythrocyte mean cell volume and hypochromia, and neutrophil toxic granulation. Provocation agents are excluded from analyte relationships.
